description: This file defines Data Access Object (DAO) classes for managing Dashboard and EmbeddedDashboard entities in the Superset project, including methods for retrieving, updating, copying, and managing dashboard metadata, filters, and favorites.

classes.name: DashboardDAO
classes.description: Data Access Object for Dashboard entities, providing methods for CRUD operations, metadata management, filtering, and favorites handling.

classes.name: EmbeddedDashboardDAO
classes.description: DAO for EmbeddedDashboard entities, managing embeddable dashboard configurations.

methods.name: get_filterable_columns_and_operators
methods.description: Returns filterable columns and operators, including custom dashboard fields.

methods.name: get_by_id_or_slug
methods.description: Retrieves a Dashboard by ID or slug, with access checks.

methods.name: get_datasets_for_dashboard
methods.description: Returns datasets associated with a dashboard.

methods.name: get_tabs_for_dashboard
methods.description: Returns tab information for a dashboard.

methods.name: get_dashboard_changed_on
methods.description: Gets the last modified datetime of a dashboard.

methods.name: get_dashboard_and_slices_changed_on
methods.description: Gets the last modified datetime considering dashboard and its slices.

methods.name: get_dashboard_and_datasets_changed_on
methods.description: Gets the last modified datetime considering dashboard and its datasets.

methods.name: validate_slug_uniqueness
methods.description: Checks if a dashboard slug is unique.

methods.name: validate_update_slug_uniqueness
methods.description: Checks if a new slug is unique for update purposes.

methods.name: set_dash_metadata
methods.description: Sets or updates dashboard metadata, including slices, positions, filters, and visual configurations.

methods.name: favorited_ids
methods.description: Returns list of favorite star IDs for dashboards.

methods.name: copy_dashboard
methods.description: Creates a copy of an existing dashboard, optionally duplicating slices.

methods.name: get_native_filter_configuration
methods.description: Retrieves native filter configuration for a dashboard.

methods.name: update_native_filters_config
methods.description: Updates native filter configuration for a dashboard.

methods.name: update_colors_config
methods.description: Updates color-related configurations in dashboard metadata.

methods.name: add_favorite
methods.description: Adds a dashboard to user's favorites.

methods.name: remove_favorite
methods.description: Removes a dashboard from user's favorites.
